Tests epoch schedule decode, derive, and slot-to-epoch conversion logic.

# Purpose
This file contains unit tests for the `fd_epoch_schedule` sysvar and its related conversion functions. It checks the binary layout of `fd_epoch_schedule_t`, verifies decode footprint and alignment values, and tests edge cases for zero or invalid schedule data. The test vectors cover warmup and normal epoch derivation, slot-to-epoch mapping, epoch start slot calculation, and epoch length calculation. It also includes a test case that matches known testnet schedule values to confirm correct behavior against real network parameters.
